title: TruthLensForensicBenchmarkStructure
description: Standardized schema for forensic media alteration benchmark datasets and evaluation runs.

pristine.description: Unmodified original camera / device capture media with intact metadata and single-generation compression.

manual_edit.description: Images with traditional manual edits (Photoshop, GIMP, splicing, cloning, local retouching).

ai_inpaint.description: Images with localized generative AI inpainting / object replacement (e.g. Stable Diffusion Inpaint, Adobe Generative Fill).

fully_generated.description: Entirely synthetic images generated by text-to-image or diffusion models (Midjourney, DALL-E 3, SDXL, Flux).

recompressed.description: Pristine or edited media subjected to multiple lossy compression cycles or social messaging platform transcoding.

disclaimer: Truth Lens does not publish synthetic accuracy claims prior to executing controlled benchmark evaluations with documented ground-truth datasets.
